title: Stir Fry Italian Peach Salsa
description: A sweet and tangy Italian-inspired peach salsa made by stir-frying peaches with rich herbs and spices. Serve it as an appetizer or side dish.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced peaches and cook for 3-4 minutes or until they start to release their juices.
3. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
4. Stir in the chopped basil and red pepper flakes. Season with salt to taste.
5. Continue to cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the peaches are tender.
6. Serve the peach salsa warm, topped with shredded mozzarella cheese if desired.
